verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public JSON-over-HTTPS REST API, but the evidence never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on all of them. The llms.txt file is a docs index, not an API specification, so it does not satisfy this story.
